name: context-injector
description: Extract code slices, relevant snippets, and file outlines for agent context.
author: madicen

entries.name: get_code_slice
entries.body: Return lines [start_line, end_line] from a file under root_path with a content hash.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute project root","required":true},{"name":"path","description":"Relative file path","required":true},{"name":"start_line","description":"1-based start line","required":true},{"name":"end_line","description":"1-based end line inclusive","required":true}]

entries.name: find_relevant_snippets
entries.body: Find token-overlap snippets under root_path bounded by max_tokens.

entries.name: get_file_outline
entries.body: Outline symbols and line ranges for a Python or Go file under root_path.
